messages.content: when did gaurdians of the galaxy 2 come out

message.content:
**Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2** came out in the U.S. on **May 5, 2017**.[1][4]

If you mean the *first release anywhere*, it premiered in **Tokyo on April 10, 2017**.[1]
